summary: Iteration 53 — Verified aggregator margin fields, routing_svc (Mapbox/OSRM fallback), and telematics (Samsara sample mode). 11/11 backend pytest passed. Frontend /fleet-routing (4 tabs, 15 rows each in Live Fleet/HOS/Safety, real OSRM route LA→PHX = 372.63mi) and /brokerage → Aggregator (MARGIN column + 4 summary tiles totaling $24,139) both verified via Playwright with data-testids.

issues: Chip label shows 'LIVE' whenever /api/telematics/provider reports mode=live, but the underlying data is still Samsara SAMPLE (because upstream 401s fall back to synthetic data). After POST /api/telematics/connect with any token, mode flips to 'live' and the SAMPLE banner disappears — visually implying real Samsara data even though we're serving synthetic. Consider distinguishing 'connected but degraded / falling back to sample' from true live so operators aren't misled. Cosmetic only — no functional bug.

action_items: Optional cosmetic: differentiate 'live-connected-but-401-fallback' from true live in the FleetRouting Live Fleet banner so users don't think they're seeing real Samsara data after a bogus /connect.
critical_code_review_comments: routing_svc.py:66 has an unused/dead line building `url` via httpx.URL(address).path immediately overwritten on next line — safe to remove.
telematics.py:_sample_hos never uses driver_name randomness anchored to a stable driver_id — status/hours change every test-day; acceptable for demo but flag if determinism per driver is desired.

/api/telematics/connect persists to Mongo (telematics_credentials collection) AND mutates os.environ, but token itself is not stored — only last4. That means after backend restart, connected=false again. Documented behavior; make sure FE surfaces this (it currently doesn't).

routing_svc.py: no rate limiting on Nominatim geocode — OSM's usage policy asks ≤1 req/s. Under load this could get the pod IP throttled. Consider caching resolved addresses in a small Mongo TTL collection.

load_aggregator margin computation uses forecast_margin_usd → carrier_pay fallback, and margin_pct back-derived from rate. When carrier_pay is missing, margin_usd could still be null and the FE tile logic uses `|| 0`, hiding that some rows lack margin. Backend test confirmed no null rows in current synthetic dataset.
seed_data_creation: One route_lookups doc inserted by test_route_by_coords_la_to_phx and asserted via /api/routing/recent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter53_routing_telematics.py can be re-run any time. Note: TestTelematics.test_connect_admin_rotates_token flips SAMSARA_API_TOKEN in-process env then pops it at the end — order within the class matters (it runs last). If the backend was restarted after a previous /connect call, telematics will report mode=sample again. Aggregator margins are deterministic per hour (synthetic loads) so totals will shift between test runs but the shape/columns/tiles remain identical. The MarginTile testids use the pattern `aggregator-margin-total`, `aggregator-margin-avg`, `aggregator-margin-avg-pct`, `aggregator-margin-high-count` (aggregator- prefix inside the MarginTile component).
